note: Projects listed in the player. Built-in examples have builtin: true. To list your own project, open a pull request that adds an entry with an absolute https URL to your .playground.json (GitHub Pages or raw.githubusercontent.com work), a title, a one-line description and your GitHub name as author. Listed community projects still ask the viewer to confirm before they run.
